data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German word 'Leisel', meaning 'God's promise'. In German folklore, Liesel was an alternate form of the name Elisabeth, which means 'God is my oath' or 'God is my pledge'. The name Liesel carries the meaning “God's promise” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Liesel usually hope their child will grow to embody god's promise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
